questions.name: durable
questions.instructions: Will this passage still be informative in a few years, after the specific products, prices, people or events it mentions are no longer current? Answer yes for explanations of how or why things work, lasting history, definitions and durable relationships; answer no for specs, prices, release dates, rankings, schedules, status updates and announcements.
